text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing the way we work. One of the biggest impacts is automation, where AI handles repetitive tasks like data entry or scheduling. This frees up employees to focus on more creative and complex problems. In addition, many companies now use AI-powered productivity tools that can summarize meetings, draft emails, or analyze large sets of data in seconds. However, the key is human-AI collaboration, not replacement. AI works best when it supports human judgment, offering suggestions that people can review and improve. As a result, some jobs will disappear, but many more will change, requiring workers to learn new digital skills and adapt to working alongside intelligent machines.
